signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story house frontage with driveway, side deck and lawn; some trees partially screen the right side.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is mowed and a clump of ornamental grass sits near the house, but there is no crew-level evidence such as crews, equipment or elaborate beds.

solar_panels.evidence: Roof shows what look like skylights rather than solar panels.

signals.notes: Ranch-style home with a raised rear/side deck, trash bins beside the deck, a wooden shed at right, and two vehicles (a sedan and a white minivan) parked in the driveway.
